UPSSSC Pharmacist Ayurvedic Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the answer key for the Post of Ayurvedic Pharmacists posts. This recruitment was released for 1002 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Pharmacist Ayurvedic Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 12 February 2024, to 03 March 2024. The examination was held on 20 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Ayurvedic Pharmacists Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 February 2024
  • Last Date : 03 March 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 March 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 11 March 2024
  • Eligibility Result : 28 July 2026
  • Mains Exam Fees Payment : 25 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 20 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 11 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 16 September 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 22 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
